title: Nashville Guesthouse • Pet Friendly • 8 min to BNA
description:
Enjoy a stylish stay just minutes from downtown Nashville, perfect for couples, solo travelers, and weekend getaways. Walk to vibrant nightlife, live music, and local dining while relaxing in a modern, comfortable space.

• Near Downtown & Broadway
• Minutes to BNA Airport
• Pet-friendly 🐾
• Walkable to shops & nightlife
• Fast WiFi + workspace
• Perfect for couples & solo stays

The space
This Modern Industrial space includes all the amenities to make you feel more at home, including:
- Per Pet Fee-$100 which is not included in the Booking rate! 
- Early Check-in is available starting from 2:00 PM instead of 4:00 PM.
- Late Check-out is available, ending at 12:00 PM instead of 10:00 AM.
-Two 55"Smart TVs (Roku for streaming)
- King-size bed
- Large walk-in closet
- Hotel Style Linens- professionally cleaned and sanitized
- Blackout curtains for all windows and door
- High Speed Wi-Fi Internet
- Individual door codes for each guest
- Fully stocked kitchen
- Keurig and K-Cups Provided

Guest access
Entire Condo is yours

Other things to note
Nashville's major attractions are in close proximity to the Condo

- Broadway/Bridgestone Arena- 9mins
- Airport (BNA)- 8mins
- Nissan Stadium- 8mins
- Nashville Zoo- 10mins
- Grand Ole Opry- 15mins
- First Tennessee Park- 10mins
- West End- 12mins
- 12 South- 10mins
- East Nashville- 12mins

Other Things to Know

- This rental is located on floor 2 using stairs or ramp access with no stairs.
- Streaming is available with your own accounts.
- This home is dog friendly with 2 dog maximum. Enjoy your dog run in the community dog park.

Trash bins are located on the backside of the complex next to the Dog Park

--Please do not order any kind of shipment on the property as mail boxes are locked by owners!

Smoking Fee - $250
